# BoredMutant

> BoredMutant builds department software, workflow automations, AI agents and company brains for firms of 50 to 500 people that have no in-house engineering team. Every build runs on top of the systems a company already uses, and a person on the client's team approves what the agents do. BoredMutant is a technology company registered in India and based in Hyderabad, working with clients in the US, UK and India.

Canonical URL: https://www.boredmutant.com/
Book a workflow review: https://cal.com/boredmutant/automations
Contact: pranith@boredmutant.com

## What we build

- Department software: a system for one team (procurement, job tracking, onboarding, renewals) with records, approvals and reports, connected to the client's ERP or accounting software.
- Workflow automations: rule-based flows that move data and tasks between existing tools, so details are not retyped into several systems.
- AI agents: agents that read, draft and route work such as quote intake, document review, support replies, sales follow-up and HR coordination. A person approves every output.
- Company brain: answers drawn from a company's documents, email and systems, respecting who is allowed to see what.

## How a project runs

1. Workflow Sprint (2 weeks, from $1,500): map one workflow or department, measure time and error rates, and build a working prototype on the client's real examples.
2. Build and launch (3 to 6 weeks, fixed price quoted after the sprint): connect systems with the least access needed, add the approval step, test, and run side by side before go-live.
3. Run and improve (monthly): monitor every run, report volume, time saved and corrections, and adjust as the process changes.

## Limits

BoredMutant does not yet hold SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certification. Patient health records and payment card data are out of scope. Demos on the site use made-up companies and data.
